title: An Email to a Friend
text:
Anna writes an email to her friend Tom. She starts with Hi Tom, because the email is informal. She tells him about her new job. She asks him to come to dinner on Friday.

Tom writes back the same day. He is happy to hear from her. He can come to dinner, but he will be a little late. He ends his email with See you soon.

questions.text: Who does Anna write an email to?
What kind of relationship do Anna and Tom probably have?
What can we guess about Tom's arrival at the dinner on Friday?
options: He will not come at all
He will arrive a little after the dinner starts

vocabulary.definition: the main meal of the evening
a person you know well and like
the work you do to earn money
after the time that was planned

paragraph_translations: Anna escribe un correo electrónico a su amigo Tom. Empieza con «Hola, Tom», porque el correo es informal. Ella le cuenta sobre su nuevo trabajo. Le pide que venga a cenar el viernes.
Tom responde el mismo día. Está contento de saber de ella. Puede ir a cenar, pero llegará un poco tarde. Termina su correo con «Nos vemos pronto».
